## Install

1. Download **gannet-v*.zip** below and unzip it. Keep the folder somewhere permanent: Chrome loads the extension from it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
3. Click **Load unpacked** and choose the unzipped folder (the one containing `manifest.json`).
4. Click the Gannet toolbar icon, or press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>G</kbd>.

**Updating:** unzip the new release over the same folder, then click the reload button on Gannet's card in `chrome://extensions`. Your settings and cached data are kept.
